name: Step 2 -- Continuous Re-entry Tolerance (EXPERIMENT, not a deliverable)
description: Replaces the 'N of 4 booleans' re-entry gate (step2_reentry_variant.json) with a continuous one: the minimum of four signed distances-past-threshold (SPY vs 200SMA, VIX headroom, SPY vs 50SMA, QQQ vs 50SMA), each as a % of its own threshold, must be >= -tolerance instead of >= 0. Zero tolerance reproduces today's exact behavior. Every other parameter held fixed at the already-recommended tuned config. Not a deliverable strategy -- lives outside strategies/*.json on purpose.

reentryToleranceBps.tier_note: NEW. The weakest of the four re-entry signals (as a signed % distance past its own threshold) may be up to this many bps short of fully clearing, instead of every signal needing to have already crossed. 0 = today's exact AND-gate behavior. 100bps = 1.00%.
